projectsPage.title: Home
projectsPage.summary: {{count}} projects · ongoing work grouped across chats and tasks
projectsPage.createDescription: Group related sessions, tasks, and workspace context without changing agent behavior.
projectsPage.workspaceSelectionHint: Choose the folder this project will use. It will not be replaced by the agent's default workspace.
projectsPage.workspaceFollowHint: When the project default agent changes, the workspace follows that agent's default workspace.
projectsPage.workspaceFixedHint: Save a fixed project path that will not change when the agent changes.
projectsPage.workspaceHint: Following the agent does not save a fixed path.

home.subtitle: See what is moving, what needs you, and what will happen next.
home.todaySummaryClear: Nothing waiting for you · {{moving}} moving forward
home.nothingNeedsYou: Nothing needs your attention right now.
home.activityEmptyBody: Important status changes will appear here as work moves forward.
home.emptyBody: Start with a conversation. When something needs continued attention, xopc will keep the context and progress together.
home.taskLabel: What do you want to keep moving forward?
home.taskPlaceholder: For example: prepare and ship the Q3 customer research report, including interviews, analysis, and a final presentation.
home.delegateDescription: Describe the task. xopc will break it down, keep it moving, and verify completion.

projectsPage.agentHintAuto: Coding workspaces will use coder when it is available.
projectsPage.agentHintCoding: Detected coding context. New project chats will default to {{agent}}.
projectsPage.agentHintCoderUnavailable: Detected coding context, but coder is unavailable. The project will use the global default.
projectsPage.agentHintGeneral: This project will use the global default agent.
projectsPage.agentHintGlobal: This project will always use the global default agent.
projectsPage.workspaceConflictDescription: This folder is already bound to “{{projectName}}”. Open that project instead?
projectsPage.workspaceMissingDescription: “{{workspace}}” does not exist yet. Create this folder and continue creating the project?
projectsPage.emptyHint: Start with a chat. Create a workspace when something grows into ongoing work.

management.title: Projects
management.subtitle: Create, find, and manage spaces for ongoing work.
management.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this project should keep moving forward.
management.emptyHint: Change the filters or create a new project.

skills.title: Project skills
skills.description: Skills installed here are available only when this project workspace is active.
skills.emptyHint: Install a skill into this project's .xopc/skills directory.
skills.marketplaceHint: Search the same skill marketplace used by the global Skills page, then install into this project.
skills.sourceHint: Use a Git repository, GitHub URL, or archive URL.
skills.uploadHint: Upload a ZIP containing SKILL.md at the root or in one folder.

projectSwitcher.createFromDirectoryDescription: Choose a directory and save it as a project. This directory becomes the project workspace.

overview.directionFallback: Add a brief or define a task so the next step is clear.
overview.noNextActions: No next actions yet. Create a task or continue the project chat to establish one.

board.title: Task board
board.description: Every card is a task xopc is responsible for advancing. Columns reflect its real execution state.
board.actionFailed: The task changed or could not be updated. The board has been restored.
board.createDescription: Add work to track over time. It stays ready until you ask xopc to advance it.
board.objectivePlaceholder: For example: complete the customer research report and verify every conclusion.
board.attachmentsDescription: Drop files here to add them as task context
board.dependenciesDescription: xopc starts this task after every selected task is complete.
board.noDependencyCandidates: There are no other tasks in this project yet.
board.createFailed: The task could not be created.

automations.title: Project automations
automations.hint: Let xopc keep advancing this project on a schedule or condition; the system chooses the execution strategy from the task and context.
automations.empty: This project has no automations. Add one when work needs ongoing follow-through.

notes.title: Project notes
notes.hint: Notes tagged to this project for decisions, references, and working context.
notes.empty: No notes are tagged to this project yet.
notes.emptyDescription: Capture a decision, reference, or next idea. It will be attached to this project automatically.
notes.noMatchesDescription: Try another keyword, or switch categories to review other project notes.
notes.quickCaptureHint: Quickly capture a project decision, reference, or next idea.
notes.bindingHint: Project notes are tagged with this project id, so they stay queryable from the global Notes page.

files.title: Project files
files.noSearchResults: No matching files in this view.
files.previewEmptyDescription: Click a file on the left to open the same preview experience used in chat.
files.needWorkspace: Set a project workspace before browsing project files.
files.boundaryHint: Files are listed only from this project workspace. Chats, tasks, and automatic advancement use the same root.
files.nextStepHint: Create a task when you want xopc to inspect or modify this workspace.

sessions.emptyDescription: Start a chat from the page header to keep its work, tasks, and summaries in this project.

settings.summaryHint: Text fields save when focus leaves them, and selections save immediately. Workspace moves, pinning, and archiving are separate actions.
settings.detailsHint: Edit directly. Changes are saved automatically when you leave a text field.
settings.name: Name
settings.nameRequired: Enter a project name before saving.
settings.descriptionHint: Shown in project lists and search results so you can quickly recognize this project.
settings.workspaceIndependentHint: Workspace moves are confirmed separately and apply immediately; the page save button does not affect them.
settings.workspaceHint: Follow mode stores no fixed path. Changing the project default agent will use the new agent's default workspace.
settings.workspaceMigrationHint: Project chats, tasks, files, and automatic advancement use this folder by default. Moving the workspace affects new context from this point on; history is not rewritten.
settings.workspaceMigrationDescription: Move this only when the project has actually moved to a new folder, or when it should follow the agent's default workspace.
settings.workspaceMigrationFixedHint: Save a fixed project folder that will not change when the agent changes.
settings.workspaceMigrationImpact: After this change, future chats, tasks, and automatic advancement will use the new folder. Files in the old folder are not moved, and historical chats are not rewritten.
settings.workspaceMissingDescription: “{{workspace}}” does not exist yet. Create this folder and move the project workspace?
settings.managementHint: Actions here affect project list placement and lifecycle; they do not modify project files.
settings.pinHint: Pinned projects appear first in project lists and the sidebar for faster access to active work.
settings.archiveHint: Archived projects leave active views, while linked chats, tasks, and files stay attached.
settings.restoreHint: Restoring moves the project back to active views so you can continue chats and advance tasks.
settings.dangerHint: Removing a project ungroups its chats, tasks, execution records, and memories. Local files are not deleted.
settings.projectGuidanceHint: Describe the project background, objectives, and handling rules so the agent can understand and advance the work reliably.
settings.briefHint: A project summary for the agent: objectives, scope, current state, and important constraints.
settings.instructionsHint: Preferences, process rules, and boundaries the agent should follow in this project.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete project "{{name}}"? Sessions and tasks will be left unassigned.
settings.deleteConfirmFallback: Delete this project? Sessions and tasks will be left unassigned.
